title: zarr-inline document
description: A Zarr v3 store as one JSON object: member names are store keys (rule R1); metadata keys hold JSON objects and byte keys hold base64 strings or inline JSON arrays/objects (rule R2). Specification 0.2.0-draft, sections 3-4. Hierarchy coherence is deliberately not checked.

propertyNames.description: R1: the empty key, or '/'-separated segments none of which is empty, '.', or '..'; no leading or trailing '/'.

(?:^|/)zarr\\.json$.description: R2 at a metadata key: a Zarr v3 metadata document.

additionalProperties.description: R2 at a byte key: base64 bytes (RFC 4648 section 4 grammar) or an inline JSON array/object whose canonical serialization is the bytes.
